United States Securities and Exchange Commission
Division of Corporation Finance

Re: C3 Capital, Inc. Withdrawal of  Offering Circular on Form 1-A, File No.
024-12366

Dear Ladies/Sirs:

This correspondence informs the Commission that the issuer, C3 Capital, Inc.
is formally withdrawing on this Form 1-A-W, the Form 1-A dated and filed under
File No. 024-12366. The issuer filed this Offering Statement under the
incorrect CIK name.

If we can be of further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us at
719-440-0333.

Sincerely,
Christopher Werner
Christopher Werner, Chairman and CEO
cc James R. Simmons, Esq.
Simmons Associates, Ltd.
